slides.title: LinkedIn headline: *Galat vs Sahi*
slides.subtitle: Profile pe sabse pehle dikhne wali line.

slides.title: Example 1
slides.after: B.Com Final Year | Excel & Tally | Looking for Accounts Internships
slides.why: Kya padh rahe ho + skills + kya dhoondh rahe ho.

slides.title: Example 2
slides.after: Aspiring Data Analyst | SQL, Python, Power BI | Projects on Sales Data
slides.why: Adjectives nahi, proof do. Sirf sach likho.

slides.title: Apni headline *AI se* banwao
slides.prompt:
Write 5 LinkedIn headlines for me, each under 200 characters.
Role I want: [target role]
My degree and year: [degree]
Top skills: [3 skills]
One project or achievement: [project]
No buzzwords like 'passionate' or 'hardworking'.
slides.note: Jo details sach hain, sirf wahi do.

slides.title: About section *bhi*
slides.body: Use the same details to ask AI for a 3-line About summary. Then edit it so it sounds like you.

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?
slides.text: Resume, LinkedIn, interview: sab ke prompts yahin.
